title: uri_to_iri and iri_to_uri drop an empty username or password
author: nyxst4ck
body_preview: `uri_to_iri()` and `iri_to_uri()` reconstruct the userinfo part of a URL using a truthiness check on `username` / `password`. Because an empty string is falsy, an empty-but-present username or password is silently dropped, even though `urllib.parse.urlsplit` distinguishes a present-but-empty component (`""`) from a missing one (`None`). title: Migrate sentinels to use Python 3.15's PEP 661 `sentinel` built-in with typing_extensions backport
author: AndreasBackx
body_preview: Migrate sentinel values like at `src/click/_utils.py` to use the introduced `sentinel` built-in coming in Python 3.15. For older versions we can use [`typing_extenions.sentinel`](https://typing-extensions.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html#typing_extensions.sentinel).
